title: Hanotsume Beading Tray
description:
Personally, I don't like beading mats because the needle gets stuck when picking up beads. I also avoid those small triangle trays since they easily flip over if you accidentally bump a corner. So, this model is my take on the ideal beading tray.

In addition to the main tray body, you can also print a matching lid, which doubles as a second tray when taken off. Note it’s slightly wider and taller.

Print Tip: Set the Top surface angle to 0° or 180° so the extrusion lines run parallel to the long edge of the tray. This makes picking up beads super satisfying, as the needle tip glides smoothly right along the grooves!
